name: body: at rest with nothing of paral's on the page the capsule is the orb alone, with no cross; while it holds a line it carries none; at rest with paral's ink on the page it carries the cross, exactly where a click on it is taken, and wears its name to the cross's left so that it is not taken for a stray button; when the ink is cleared the cross and the name go
